library.name: DeterministicESPAsyncWebServer
library.author: Douglas Quigg (dstroy0) <dquigg123@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Zero-heap, asynchronous multi-protocol network server for ESP32 with a fully deterministic memory footprint.
library.paragraph: Serves RFC 7230 HTTP/1.1 (routes matched in insertion order; the parser validates every request byte-by-byte and auto-sends 400/413/414/501 with no application code), WebSocket (RFC 6455), Server-Sent Events, Basic/Digest auth, static file serving, multipart, JSON, templating, and a middleware pipeline, plus opt-in HTTPS/TLS, SSH, Telnet, and SNMP (v1/v2c/v3). All buffers are statically sized at compile time and no heap is used after begin(); feature flags strip unused subsystems.

library.name: NiusCam
library.author: dunknowcoding
library.sentence: Typed camera capture, control, storage, and streaming for ESP32 camera modules as AI Thinker, XIAO S3 Sense, ESP32-S3-Cam.
library.paragraph: Provides verified board and optical-module profiles, optional OV5640 direct-PSRAM DMA and autofocus, OV2640 low-light timing, safe frame ownership, capability-aware controls, microSD storage, HTTP/MJPEG and CRC-protected UDP streaming, diagnostics, recovery, and configurable performance profiles on top of Espressif's bundled camera driver.

library.name: PIDEasy-Improved
library.author: Kaleo S. Mendonça
library.sentence: A simple and efficient PID controller library for Arduino.
library.paragraph: Includes support for gain adjustment, integral limit (anti-windup), derivative term smoothing, and output constraint.

library.name: python esp bridge
library.author: Hamza Yesilmen <resmiyslmn@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Flash-once firmware that exposes every peripheral to Python over USB serial or Bluetooth.
library.paragraph: Turns an ESP32 into a live bridge — GPIO, ADC/DAC, PWM, touch, I2C, SPI, UART, Wi-Fi sockets, BLE, ESP-NOW, RMT, 1-Wire, CAN, I2S, filesystem, NVS and OTA are all driven from the host with the python-esp-bridge package (pip install python-esp-bridge). One EspBridge.begin() call starts a FreeRTOS task model (separate TX, RX and network tasks) so blocking radio I/O never stalls peripheral traffic. Requires arduino-esp32 core 3.x. Also runs on the Nordic nRF52840 (Seeed XIAO / Adafruit Bluefruit core) with a capability-gated subset: BLE link, GPIO, ADC, PWM and I2C.
